_note: User-facing notes, newest first: the Today card after an update and the update window (scripts/release-notes.py) both read this file. Every release adds its version here; 1-3 items, each a short title and one or two plain sentences. action: settings:<pane> or page:<today|apps|log|automations>.

items.title: Sharper Release Dates & Sentry Triage
items.detail: Live version release dates match the timeline in your local timezone, fatal freezes clearly separate older versions from the live build, hm services ranks real crashes first, and Stability adds a one-click Copy brief for Claude button.

items.title: Revenue & Subscriber Priority First
items.detail: Active subscriber and MRR drops now stay ranked ahead of static star-rating notices in Today's story, while chart sub-labels and funnel totals display cleanly without number clipping.

items.title: Cleaner AI Grants & Stale Usage Flags
items.detail: Exhausted one-time AI credit grants retire into a quiet summary line instead of counting as running hot, and expired usage readings are flagged clearly in the app and hm usage.

items.title: Clearer Automations Timeline
items.detail: Overlapping 12 am dots spread cleanly apart, hovering any dot identifies its exact job, future runs show Later today instead of Ran, and Dark Mode dots and legend stay crisp.

items.title: Sharper Today Story & Priority Ranking
items.detail: Wins and Worries align across headline and cards with app labels, channel icons, and baseline deltas, while revenue and subscriber drops rank ahead of stale review notices.

items.title: Readable Outreach Forms & Links
items.detail: Toggles and long App Store campaign links wrap across lines cleanly inside Outreach detail sheets without text cutoff.

items.title: Smart Setup & Vercel Auto-Fill
items.detail: Find my key discovers and auto-fills Vercel teams, projects, sites, GitHub repos, and AI provider keys from Keychain, env files, and Vercel CLI. OpenAI, Gemini, and Groq include built-in pricing.

items.title: Release Updates & Smart Outreach
items.detail: Notify opt-in customer subscribers on new App Store releases with spam lint, test sends, and unsubscribe tracking. Outreach uses App Store highlights, clean reply filters, spinners, and Safari Zoho sign-in support.

items.title: Smart Autopilot & Release Checks
items.detail: Enable Smart Autopilot for badged agents while keeping submit, sends, replies, and keys owner-only. Apps shows a Ready to submit checklist, proactive review replies wait in Log, and batch approval skips critical items.

items.title: Replay a sale’s moment
items.detail: Right-click any purchase on Today, or Replay last purchase animation in the menu bar panel (the panel closes first). It uses the real purchase and does not add a new one or send a notification.

items.title: Every payment gets its own moment
items.detail: Free trials, intro offers, refunds and the other payment events now appear in Purchases, the ticker and the menu bar’s Latest list, and each plays its own short moment, not only paid sales and renewals.

items.title: A sale you missed still plays when you come back
items.detail: If a payment arrived while Hmunmawi wasn’t in front, its moment plays when you bring the window back, even if a few minutes have passed.

items.title: Safari stays tidy
items.detail: Hmunmawi's Safari reads (X, Zoho Mail, payouts, offer codes) now take turns, open their own tab and always close it again. X unfollows no longer stop for the day with "lost its tab".

items.title: Needs a look, not needs fixing
items.detail: Your scripts can now flag something to look at without calling it a failure. It shows amber, counts in the health pill, alerts once a day at most and clears when the script reports ok.

items.title: Live sales buttons open the right place
items.detail: Live sales is in Settings → General. The What's new buttons and messages about your worker now point there.

items.title: A new token when Cloudflare refuses the old one
items.detail: If Cloudflare refuses the token saved for your live-sales worker, Live sales says so and asks for a new one next to Update worker.

items.title: See what changed after each update
items.detail: After an update, Today shows what is new since the version you last used, once, with a button to each new screen. The update window shows the same notes before you install.

items.title: Worker updates with a one-account token
items.detail: Updating your live-sales worker now also works with a Cloudflare token that is limited to one account.

items.title: Your live-sales worker stays up to date
items.detail: When a new version changes the worker, Hmunmawi updates the one in your Cloudflare account by itself. Update worker in Live sales does it on demand.

items.title: Settings in groups, and Set up… for jobs
items.detail: The Settings sidebar is grouped like System Settings, and Settings → Jobs has a Set up… button for each job Hmunmawi can run for you.

items.title: Agents without a badge always ask
items.detail: Once you give your agents badges, one that sends no badge waits for your OK, even in Full Autopilot.

items.title: Clearer Today cards
items.detail: Worries are never green, the Money card says what its change measures, and the Health card's sentence matches its number.

start_here.title: Today is your daily answer
start_here.detail: One sentence each morning: what went well, what to watch and what to do next. Sample numbers show until your own arrive.

start_here.title: Connect your apps
start_here.detail: Settings → Connections: App Store Connect first, then any other source you use. Keys stay in your Keychain.

start_here.title: Let routines watch for you
start_here.detail: Automations runs checks on a schedule and asks before it changes anything outside Hmunmawi.
